interactionGovernance.description.en: Thread interactions are open by default: anyone in the company — the board or any agent, including the one that asked — can respond. Narrow a kind only when you need to. Default policy is the audience new cards get when the requester does not ask for one; cap narrows every request of that kind and can never widen one. Tool-approval confirmations always stay human only.
interactionGovernance.description.zh-CN: 线程交互默认开放：公司中的任何人都可以响应，包括看板、任意智能体以及发起交互的智能体。仅在需要时缩小某类交互的范围。默认政策是在请求者未指定时新卡片采用的受众；上限会缩小该类交互的每个请求，且绝不会放宽。工具审批确认始终仅限人工处理。

interactionGovernance.effect.humanOnlyCa.zh-CN: 每个请求都仅限人工处理。

interactionGovernance.effect.humanOnlyDe.en: Only humans can resolve this interaction by default.
interactionGovernance.effect.humanOnlyDe.zh-CN: 默认情况下，仅人工可以处理此交互。

interactionGovernance.effect.noCap.en: No cap; use the audience requested by the interaction.
interactionGovernance.effect.noCap.zh-CN: 不设上限；采用交互请求指定的受众。

interactionGovernance.effect.notCreatorC.zh-CN: 每个请求都会排除其创建者。

interactionGovernance.effect.notCreatorD.en: The creator cannot resolve its own interaction by default.
interactionGovernance.effect.notCreatorD.zh-CN: 默认情况下，创建者不能处理自己发起的交互。

interactionGovernance.effect.openDefault.en: Anyone in the company can respond unless the requester narrows the audience.
interactionGovernance.effect.openDefault.zh-CN: 除非请求者缩小受众范围，否则公司中的任何人都可以响应。
